summary.text: John Gillespie is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 97 who has served since November 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: John Gillespie was born in Memphis, Tennessee, and earned a B.A. in political science from High Point University.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a financial service representative with First Tennessee Bank and a grant coordinator with Trezevant Episcopal Home.
He succeeded Jim Coley in House District 97 and assumed office on November 3, 2020.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Criminal Justice Committee and a member of the Education Administration and Health committees.
